name: av_crypto_daily
description:
Historical daily prices for one cryptocurrency from Alpha Vantage (DIGITAL_CURRENCY_DAILY).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Time Series (Digital Currency Daily)"} keyed by date, each with open, high, low, close and volume in the chosen market currency.
Inputs (* required): symbol (crypto code such as BTC or ETH; default BTC); market (fiat currency code; default USD).
Related: av_crypto_weekly; current rate: av_forex_rate with from=BTC; other sources: openbb_crypto_price, yf_crypto_info, cg_coin_market_chart.
Example: {"symbol": "ETH", "market": "USD"}

market.description: Fiat market currency code, e.g. USD, EUR
